Schools and universities

Term schedules, shared washrooms and changing occupancy make operating-day assumptions especially important.

Use the school calendar

Separate teaching days, summer use and evening activities. A full-year default may overstate use in a seasonal building.

Plan staff handover

Include custodial teams in the review and document the routine for substitute staff. Schedule disruptive work around building access and class time.
